review_notes: I read all of Gate.lean. I also grepped the LeanQuantumAlg directory for copies of the inner-product proof's main steps (`Finset.sum_mul_sum`, `mem_unitaryGroup_iff'`). The only repeated proofs are the `applyVec_add`, `applyVec_sub`, `applyVec_smul` and `applyVec_neg` family, plus `add_applyVec` and `smul_applyVec`. Each is a three-line unfold, rewrite, `rfl` step around one existing Mathlib lemma, which the rubric treats as routine unfolding. The `Gate.*` versions are thin wrappers around the `HilbertOperator.*` versions. The long inner-product proof appears only once. `Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'` shows up in the unitarity argument at line 115 and in `conjTranspose` at line 234. Both uses are one-line rewrites. `QFT.lean` line 175 and `QPE.lean` line 170 also use it, but I did not open them, so I can't say whether they repeat more than that. I found no nontrivial repeated reasoning that justifies a shared lemma.
